title: Parliament Proposal
description: A request to make a durable change to governed state, put to a weighted multi-agent vote. Parliament does not use majority rule. A vote is a stake: each voter commits confidence that is later scored against the realized outcome, and that score recalibrates the voter's future weight. Final consensus combines structural authority (quorum_weight), earned track record (calibration_weight), domain relevance (so an out-of-lane agent cannot drive a decision), and the stake itself. This sidesteps Arrow's impossibility result by aggregating predictions-with-skin-in-the-game rather than raw preferences.

proposal_id.description: Stable unique identifier for this proposal.

proposal_type.description: The kind of durable change being decided.

subject_ref.description: What the proposal concerns: a belief_id, decision id, or agent_id (for trust-weight changes).

proposition.description: Natural-language statement of exactly what passing this proposal would make true.

domain.description: Domain(s) this proposal touches (e.g. ['semiconductors','equity-valuation']). Matched against each voter's domain_authorities to compute domain_relevance.

voting_deadline.description: Optional cutoff after which the proposal resolves on the votes received.

resolution.description: Present once the proposal is resolved.

QuorumPolicy.description: Rules that decide whether and how the proposal passes.

min_votes.description: Minimum number of votes (any position) required for a valid resolution.

min_weighted_consensus.description: Weighted-consensus threshold in [0,1] the proposal must reach to pass.

aggregation.description: Aggregation method. weighted_consensus = support_weight / (support_weight + oppose_weight) over effective weights.

authority_scoping.description: If true, each vote's weight is scaled by the voter's domain_relevance to the proposal domain.

Vote.description: A single agent's stake on the proposal. Not a preference — a scored commitment.

staked_confidence.description: How strongly the voter commits, in [0,1]. Capped by the voter's confidence_ceiling. This is what gets scored against the realized outcome.

voter_quorum_weight.description: Structural authority of the voter at vote time (from AgentIdentity.quorum_weight).

voter_calibration_weight.description: Earned track record of the voter at vote time (Brier-derived, from Belief Envelope calibration).

domain_relevance.description: How relevant the voter's authority is to the proposal domain, in [0,1]. 1 = directly authoritative; low = out of lane.

Resolution.description: The aggregated, auditable outcome. Every effective weight is recorded so the decision can be reconstructed.

effective_weight_formula.description: Human-readable description of the weighting used, for audit. E.g. 'quorum_weight * calibration_weight * domain_relevance * staked_confidence'.

resulting_status.description: Epistemic status the subject transitions to if the proposal passed.
